answer_raw:
For a six-month stay that balances safety, beach access, and walkability, **Lagoa da Conceição** is your best option, though **Jurerê Internacional** is the premium alternative if budget is secondary to security.

**Lagoa da Conceição** offers the best balance for your requirements; it serves as the heart of the island with an active lifestyle, full infrastructure (supermarkets and services), and a lively nightlife [4]. While it is a high-priced, coveted area, it is ideal for those seeking a mix of nature and urban convenience [4]. Because it is not a pedestrian-centric city by design, you should note that while the lagoon offers great outdoor activities, you may need a vehicle for certain trips [7].

**Jurerê Internacional** is the high-end choice with a safety score of 78/100 and zero reported robberies as of May 2026 [6]. It is a more expensive, resort-style environment where a one-bedroom might cost roughly €1,200/month as of May 2026 [6].

**Centro** is the only area where you can genuinely live without a car, offering the best walkability on the island, though it lacks direct beach access [7].

**Campeche** and **Ingleses** offer lower rent profiles, with prices starting around R$ 4,500/m² as of June 2026, but they differ significantly in character from the more central or northern districts [4].

Regarding your requirement for fast internet, the effectiveness of your connection will depend heavily on the specific bairro; choosing the wrong one can result in slow Wi-Fi and isolation [7]. While the city has a high density of security cameras, coverage is often concentrated in just three neighborhoods, so you should verify local infrastructure before committing to a lease [6].
